comparison.objective: Release two simultaneous latches, remove a lid, and set it down.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual inward latch actuation followed by coordinated lifting and placement.
comparison.success_condition: Lid flat beside the case and still for 1 s; partial credit for one/both latch release and lift clearance; excessive case motion zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous latch release and lid extraction, not load-sharing agitation or selective passage of mixed contents.
